counters.why: Players commonly point to Prowler for Domino; his non-contact Medium attacks and non-critical damage pattern reduce some of the usual friction in the matchup.
counters.strategy: Use non-contact Medium attacks to build the rotation, apply Rupture, and control Power before committing the main Special Attack burst.
counters.risks: Prowler is not immune to Critical Failure. Domino can still punish unlucky ability checks and node interactions.
conditions: Do not treat this as Critical Failure immunity.
Keep enough spacing to react if Domino's Evade or Special Attack timing disrupts the rotation.
counters.scoreReason: Community counter discussions repeatedly support Prowler; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Community reports use Count Nefaria into Domino because his Energy Resistance can reduce the cost of Critical Failure while his own Evade can help against projectile Specials.
counters.strategy: Build Ionic Overcharge through the normal Well-Timed Block and Evade loop, then punish Special Attacks and use the resistance window to keep the fight stable.
counters.risks: Nefaria is not immune to Domino's Ability Accuracy Reduction or Critical Failure. The matchup reduces risk; it does not erase it.
conditions: Treat Energy Resistance as mitigation, not immunity.
Do not rely on an Evade timing you have not practiced against Domino's Special Attacks.
counters.scoreReason: Community counter discussions support Nefaria; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Sunspot is repeatedly reported as a Dust counter because Incinerate can remove Sand and interfere with her Sandstorm setup.
counters.strategy: Apply Incinerate consistently, avoid unnecessary hits into Dust's Block, and use the contact Medium Attack if you need a Parry-Stun opening.
counters.risks: Dust's Light Attacks are non-contact, so careless Parry attempts can build Sand instead of giving you control.
conditions: Use Incinerate to manage Sand rather than relying on Shock or Bleed.
Parry only a contact attack when you need the Stun opening.
counters.scoreReason: Community counter discussions repeatedly support Sunspot; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Kushala is a current player-reported Dust option, and her Incinerate access gives her the useful Sand-removal interaction.
counters.strategy: Build Incinerates through safe openings, keep them active to manage Sand, and use Soul Barb only when Dust's Buffs or nodes make it relevant.
counters.risks: Kushala does not make Dust's non-contact Light Attacks safe to Parry. A poor defensive rhythm can still trigger Sandstorm.
conditions: Prioritize Incinerate uptime over an elaborate rotation.
Avoid repeated Block hits and non-contact Parry attempts.
counters.scoreReason: Community counter discussions support Kushala; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Players report Deathless Thanos into Red Skull; Armor Shattered directly attacks the Armor Up stack that drives much of Red Skull's defense.
counters.strategy: Use Heavy Attack to establish Armor Shattered, avoid mindless Block-hitting, then use Fury and Corrosion Specials once Red Skull's Armor pressure is reduced.
counters.risks: Red Skull's Power and Auto-Block mechanics can still punish sloppy contact into his Block, especially on defensive nodes.
conditions: Do not use Block-hitting as the default way to open the fight.
Check whether the placement protects Armor Up or punishes Armor Break or Armor Shattered effects.
counters.scoreReason: Community counter discussions support Deathless Thanos; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Galan is a widely reported Red Skull option because Red Skull's many Armor Up Buffs give Galan abundant buff-based ramp for Harvest damage.
counters.strategy: Let Red Skull's Armor Up contribute to Galan's Planetary Mass, keep the fight controlled around Auto-Block, then cash out with Harvest from a safe opening.
counters.risks: Do not over-hit Red Skull's Block while trying to ramp. A node that suppresses Buffs or direct damage can change the matchup.
conditions: Build around Red Skull's Armor Up rather than trying to remove every stack.
Respect Auto-Block and Power Drain while setting up Harvest.
counters.scoreReason: Community counter discussions repeatedly support Galan; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Kate Bishop is a current community-listed Spider-Ham counter; Coldsnap and True Accuracy give her practical Evade control while she maintains ranged pressure.
counters.strategy: Set up Coldsnap and Trick Arrow pressure, keep True Accuracy available for Evade control, and bait Specials instead of feeding Porker Poppers with careless Special Attack use.
counters.risks: Porker Poppers still punish poor Special Attack timing, and the Evade interaction depends on keeping your anti-Evade effect available.
conditions: Keep an anti-Evade effect active before committing to long combos.
Do not throw Special Attacks blindly while Porker Popper pressure is high.
counters.scoreReason: Community counter discussions support Kate Bishop; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Players list Deathless Thanos as a Spider-Ham answer; Counterpunch can create safer openings while Corrosion supplies steady damage.
counters.strategy: Use controlled intercepts and Counterpunch openings, avoid unnecessary Special Attack spam, and let Corrosion contribute damage while you manage Porker Poppers.
counters.risks: This is a community option, not a claim that Deathless Thanos turns off Spider-Ham's Evade or Porker Popper mechanics.
conditions: Manage Porker Poppers before committing repeated Special Attacks.
counters.scoreReason: Community counter discussions support Deathless Thanos; no independent current-season timing test is recorded.
